  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}

  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}

  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}

<div style="width: 800px; height: 480px; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #fff; overflow: hidden;">
  <svg viewBox="0 0 800 480" width="800" height="480" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" shape-rendering="crispEdges">
    <defs>
      <pattern id="gb-dither" width="4" height="4" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="2" height="2" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="2" y="2" width="2" height="2" fill="#000" />
      </pattern>
      <pattern id="gb-brick" width="16" height="8" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="16" height="2" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="2" height="8" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="8" y="4" width="2" height="4" fill="#000" />
      </pattern>
      <pattern id="gb-stripes" width="6" height="6" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="3" height="6" fill="#000" />
      </pattern>

      <!-- Shared 8-Bit Reindeer -->
      <g id="gb-deer">
        <rect x="28" y="0" width="4" height="12" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="24" y="4" width="4" height="4" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="36" y="0" width="4" height="10" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="40" y="4" width="4" height="4" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="26" y="10" width="14" height="12" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="38" y="12" width="8" height="8" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="32" y="12" width="4" height="4" fill="#fff" />
        <rect x="44" y="14" width="4" height="4" fill="#fff" />
        <rect x="22" y="18" width="10" height="8" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="6" y="22" width="26" height="12" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="2" y="20" width="6" height="6" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="24" y="32" width="4" height="8" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="28" y="38" width="6" height="4" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="20" y="32" width="4" height="6" fill="#000" />

        <rect x="6" y="36" width="4" height="6" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="16" y="32" width="4" height="8" fill="#000" />
        <rect x="22" y="24" width="4" height="6" fill="#fff" />
      </g>
    </defs>

    <!-- SCENE 0: Santa, Sleigh & 8 Reindeer with Giant Hero Present -->
    {% if scene_index == 0 %}
      <!-- Night Sky pixel stars -->

","half_vertical":"{% assign offset = trmnl.user.utc_offset | default: 0 %}
{% assign now_ts = "now" | date: "%s" | plus: offset %}
{% assign cur_year = now_ts | date: "%Y" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_hour = now_ts | date: "%H" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign manual_step = scene_offset | default: 0 | plus: 0 %}
{% assign mode = display_mode | default: "fixed" %}
{% if mode == "rotate" %}
  {% assign r_interval = rotation_interval | default: "daily" %}
  {% if r_interval == "hourly" %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | times: 24 | plus: cur_hour | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% else %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% endif %}
{% else %}
  {% assign sel = selected_scene | default: "santa_sleigh" %}
  {% if sel == "santa_sleigh" %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% elsif sel == "chimney_drop" %}{% assign scene_index = 1 %}
  {% elsif sel == "elf_workshop" %}{% assign scene_index = 2 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_tree" %}{% assign scene_index = 3 %}
  {% elsif sel == "snow_globe" %}{% assign scene_index = 4 %}
  {% elsif sel == "cabin_retreat" %}{% assign scene_index = 5 %}
  {% elsif sel == "polar_express" %}{% assign scene_index = 6 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_stocking" %}{% assign scene_index = 7 %}
  {% else %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% endif %}
  {% assign scene_index = scene_index | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
{% endif %}

","full.liquid":"{% assign offset = trmnl.user.utc_offset | default: 0 %}
{% assign now_ts = "now" | date: "%s" | plus: offset %}
{% assign cur_year = now_ts | date: "%Y" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_hour = now_ts | date: "%H" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign manual_step = scene_offset | default: 0 | plus: 0 %}
{% assign mode = display_mode | default: "fixed" %}
{% if mode == "rotate" %}
  {% assign r_interval = rotation_interval | default: "daily" %}
  {% if r_interval == "hourly" %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | times: 24 | plus: cur_hour | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% else %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% endif %}
{% else %}
  {% assign sel = selected_scene | default: "santa_sleigh" %}
  {% if sel == "santa_sleigh" %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% elsif sel == "chimney_drop" %}{% assign scene_index = 1 %}
  {% elsif sel == "elf_workshop" %}{% assign scene_index = 2 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_tree" %}{% assign scene_index = 3 %}
  {% elsif sel == "snow_globe" %}{% assign scene_index = 4 %}
  {% elsif sel == "cabin_retreat" %}{% assign scene_index = 5 %}
  {% elsif sel == "polar_express" %}{% assign scene_index = 6 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_stocking" %}{% assign scene_index = 7 %}
  {% else %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% endif %}
  {% assign scene_index = scene_index | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
{% endif %}

  {% if mod100 != 0 %}

custom_fields:

  - 'Every Hour': hourly

  default: 0
  help_text: Increment or adjust this number anytime to instantly flip through scenes while testing.","full.liquid":"{% assign offset = trmnl.user.utc_offset | default: 0 %}

{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_hour = now_ts | date: "%H" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign manual_step = scene_offset | default: 0 | plus: 0 %}
{% assign mode = display_mode | default: "fixed" %}
{% if mode == "rotate" %}
  {% assign r_interval = rotation_interval | default: "daily" %}
  {% if r_interval == "hourly" %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | times: 24 | plus: cur_hour | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% else %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% endif %}
{% else %}
  {% assign sel = selected_scene | default: "santa_sleigh" %}
  {% if sel == "santa_sleigh" %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% elsif sel == "chimney_drop" %}{% assign scene_index = 1 %}
  {% elsif sel == "elf_workshop" %}{% assign scene_index = 2 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_tree" %}{% assign scene_index = 3 %}
  {% elsif sel == "cabin_retreat" %}{% assign scene_index = 4 %}

  {% elsif sel == "snow_globe" %}{% assign scene_index = 7 %}
  {% else %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% endif %}
  {% assign scene_index = scene_index | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
{% endif %}

<div style="width:800px;height:480px;margin:0;padding:0;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;">

  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign manual_step = scene_offset | default: 0 | plus: 0 %}
{% assign mode = display_mode | default: "fixed" %}
{% if mode == "rotate" %}
  {% assign r_interval = rotation_interval | default: "daily" %}
  {% if r_interval == "hourly" %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | times: 24 | plus: cur_hour | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% else %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% endif %}
{% else %}
  {% assign sel = selected_scene | default: "santa_sleigh" %}
  {% if sel == "santa_sleigh" %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% elsif sel == "chimney_drop" %}{% assign scene_index = 1 %}

  {% elsif sel == "snow_globe" %}{% assign scene_index = 7 %}
  {% else %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% endif %}
  {% assign scene_index = scene_index | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
{% endif %}

custom_fields:
- keyname: about

  options:

  - '2. Chimney Rooftop Descent': chimney_drop
  - '3. North Pole Elf Toy Workshop': elf_workshop
  - '4. Giant Town Square Tree': giant_tree
  - '5. Cozy Winter Forest Cabin': cabin_retreat
  - '6. North Pole Express Steam Train': polar_express
  - '7. Fireside Hearth & Stockings': giant_stocking
  - '8. Enchanted Snow Globe': snow_globe
  default: santa_sleigh

  options:
  - 'Every Hour': hourly
  - 'Every Day': daily

{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_hour = now_ts | date: "%H" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign manual_step = scene_offset | default: 0 | plus: 0 %}
{% assign mode = display_mode | default: "fixed" %}
{% if mode == "rotate" %}
  {% assign r_interval = rotation_interval | default: "daily" %}
  {% if r_interval == "hourly" %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | times: 24 | plus: cur_hour | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% else %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% endif %}
{% else %}
  {% assign sel = selected_scene | default: "santa_sleigh" %}
  {% if sel == "santa_sleigh" %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% elsif sel == "chimney_drop" %}{% assign scene_index = 1 %}
  {% elsif sel == "elf_workshop" %}{% assign scene_index = 2 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_tree" %}{% assign scene_index = 3 %}

  {% elsif sel == "snow_globe" %}{% assign scene_index = 7 %}
  {% else %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% endif %}
  {% assign scene_index = scene_index | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
{% endif %}

    <!-- ==================== SCENE 0: SANTA & 8 REINDEER ==================== -->

  default: santa_sleigh

  name: Rotation Interval (if Rotating)
  options:
  - 'Every Hour': hourly
  - 'Every Day': daily
  default: daily

  default: 0
  help_text: Increment or adjust this number anytime to instantly test and cycle scenes.","full.liquid":"{% assign offset = trmnl.user.utc_offset | default: 0 %}

{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_hour = now_ts | date: "%H" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign manual_step = scene_offset | default: 0 | plus: 0 %}
{% assign mode = display_mode | default: "fixed" %}
{% if mode == "rotate" %}
  {% assign r_interval = rotation_interval | default: "daily" %}
  {% if r_interval == "hourly" %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | times: 24 | plus: cur_hour | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% else %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% endif %}
{% else %}
  {% assign sel = selected_scene | default: "santa_sleigh" %}
  {% if sel == "santa_sleigh" %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}

  {% elsif sel == "snow_globe" %}{% assign scene_index = 7 %}
  {% else %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% endif %}
  {% assign scene_index = scene_index | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
{% endif %}

","half_vertical":"{% assign offset = trmnl.user.utc_offset | default: 0 %}
{% assign now_ts = "now" | date: "%s" | plus: offset %}
{% assign cur_year = now_ts | date: "%Y" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

","full.liquid":"{% assign offset = trmnl.user.utc_offset | default: 0 %}
{% assign now_ts = "now" | date: "%s" | plus: offset %}
{% assign cur_year = now_ts | date: "%Y" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_hour = now_ts | date: "%H" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign rot_mode = scene_rotation | default: 'single' %}
{% assign active_scene = selected_scene | default: 'sleigh' %}

{% if rot_mode == 'rotate_daily' %}
  {% assign scene_idx = cur_yday | modulo: 5 %}
  {% if scene_idx == 0 %}{% assign active_scene = 'sleigh' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 1 %}{% assign active_scene = 'icons' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 2 %}{% assign active_scene = 'hearth' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 3 %}{% assign active_scene = 'cabin' %}{% else %}{% assign active_scene = 'northpole' %}{% endif %}
{% elsif rot_mode == 'rotate_hourly' %}
  {% assign scene_idx = cur_hour | modulo: 5 %}
  {% if scene_idx == 0 %}{% assign active_scene = 'sleigh' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 1 %}{% assign active_scene = 'icons' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 2 %}{% assign active_scene = 'hearth' %}{% elsif scene_idx == 3 %}{% assign active_scene = 'cabin' %}{% else %}{% assign active_scene = 'northpole' %}{% endif %}
{% endif %}

","half_vertical.liquid":"{% assign offset = trmnl.user.utc_offset | default: 0 %}
{% assign now_ts = "now" | date: "%s" | plus: offset %}
{% assign cur_year = now_ts | date: "%Y" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{"ref":"local:christmas-countdown-wl1tx","name":"Christmas Countdown","description":"Christmas countdown styled after classic 1-bit Game Boy Pocket pixel art scenes with Santa's sleigh, 8 reindeer, Santa's workshop, hearth, cabin, and icon gallery.","screenshotUrl":"/admin/thumb/christmas-countdown-wl1tx.png","settings":{"name":"Christmas Countdown","strategy":"static","static_data":"{"title": "Christmas Countdown"}","custom_fields":[{"keyname":"about","field_type":"author_bio","name":"About This Plugin","description":"Christmas countdown styled after classic 1-bit Game Boy Pocket pixel art scenes with Santa's sleigh, 8 reindeer, Santa's workshop, hearth, cabin, and icon gallery."},{"keyname":"scene_rotation","field_type":"select","name":"Scene Selection Mode","options":[{"Single Scene (Select Below)":"single"},{"Rotate Daily":"rotate_daily"},{"Rotate Hourly":"rotate_hourly"}],"default":"single"},{"keyname":"selected_scene","field_type":"select","name":"Active Scene","options":[{"Santa Sleigh & 8 Reindeer Flight":"sleigh"},{"Santa's Workshop":"workshop"},{"Retro 16-Icon Pixel Art Gallery":"icons"},{"Cozy Hearth & Stocking Fireplace":"hearth"},{"Pine Forest & Moonlit Cabin":"cabin"}],"default":"sleigh"}]},"templates":{"shared":"","full":"{% assign offset = trmnl.user.utc_offset | default: 0 %}

{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}

{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}

{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}

  {% assign year_len = 366 %}

  {% assign year_len = 365 %}

{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}

{% assign cur_year = now_ts | date: "%Y" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_yday = now_ts | date: "%j" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign cur_hour = now_ts | date: "%H" | plus: 0 %}
{% assign is_leap = 0 %}
{% assign mod4 = cur_year | modulo: 4 %}
{% assign mod100 = cur_year | modulo: 100 %}
{% assign mod400 = cur_year | modulo: 400 %}
{% if mod4 == 0 %}
  {% if mod100 != 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% elsif mod400 == 0 %}
    {% assign is_leap = 1 %}
  {% endif %}
{% endif %}
{% if is_leap == 1 %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 360 %}
  {% assign year_len = 366 %}
{% else %}
  {% assign xmas_day = 359 %}
  {% assign year_len = 365 %}
{% endif %}
{% if cur_yday <= xmas_day %}
  {% assign days_left = xmas_day | minus: cur_yday %}
{% else %}
  {% assign days_left = year_len | minus: cur_yday | plus: 359 %}
{% endif %}

{% assign manual_step = scene_offset | default: 0 | plus: 0 %}
{% assign mode = display_mode | default: "fixed" %}
{% if mode == "rotate" %}
  {% assign r_interval = rotation_interval | default: "daily" %}
  {% if r_interval == "hourly" %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | times: 24 | plus: cur_hour | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% else %}
    {% assign scene_index = cur_yday | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}
  {% endif %}
{% else %}
  {% assign sel = selected_scene | default: "santa_sleigh" %}
  {% if sel == "santa_sleigh" %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% elsif sel == "chimney_drop" %}{% assign scene_index = 1 %}
  {% elsif sel == "elf_workshop" %}{% assign scene_index = 2 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_tree" %}{% assign scene_index = 3 %}
  {% elsif sel == "cabin_retreat" %}{% assign scene_index = 4 %}
  {% elsif sel == "polar_express" %}{% assign scene_index = 5 %}
  {% elsif sel == "giant_stocking" %}{% assign scene_index = 6 %}
  {% elsif sel == "snow_globe" %}{% assign scene_index = 7 %}
  {% else %}{% assign scene_index = 0 %}
  {% endif %}
  {% assign scene_index = scene_index | plus: manual_step | modulo: 8 %}

    {% else %}
